note: Walking routes between every pair of points (shops and the stops of the traveller's day), for the "build your own route" map. Computed once with the FOSSGIS OSRM foot profile (routing.openstreetmap.de) on OpenStreetMap data (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL).
